memoryFileVersionConflict: This version of {path} can no longer be changed: {detail}. Read it again, merge your changes in, then write.
memoryFileVersionMoved: you read version {expected}, and it's now version {current}
memoryIndexNotDeleted: The index itself isn't deleted — it isn't the first memory of a scope. To clear it, write it as an empty file
memoryOwnOnly: You can only view memories about yourself
memoryScopeInvalid: scope must be team or private
migrationAnswerUnreadable: The model's answer for this batch can't be read: {reason}
migrationCreateExists: {source} is to create {target}, but it already exists. Use merge to change it
migrationDecisionNotObject: An entry in decisions isn't an object: {item}
migrationDestinationInvalid: {source}'s destination can only be team / private / merge / suggest / discard, got {destination}
migrationDuplicateSource: The old memories have a duplicate source_id, so the report doesn't add up
migrationIntoIndex: {source} is to go into {index}. The index only holds one-line pointers, not bodies
migrationMergeNoBody: {source} is to be merged but gives no body
migrationMergeTargetMissing: {source} is to be merged into {target}, but that memory isn't there (merge only goes into one that already exists)
migrationNameNotKebab: {source} gives a file name that isn't kebab-case: {name}
migrationNoDecisions: The JSON the model returned has no decisions list
migrationNoDescription: {source} gives no description (the hook on its index line)
migrationNoModel: No model is configured, and moving memories needs a model to decide where each goes
migrationNoReason: {source} gives no reason. Every entry on the report needs one sentence
migrationNotJson: What the model returned isn't JSON: {error}
migrationNothingToMove: This project has no old memories left to move
migrationOwnerNotInMigration: {source} is to go into {owner}'s private memory, but that person isn't in this migration
migrationPersonalIntoTeam: {source} comes from the “about a person” pool and can't go into team (private content may not become a rule for the whole project)
migrationPlanAlreadyDecided: This plan is already {status} and can't be approved again
migrationPlanInvalid: This version of the migration plan doesn't hold up: {reason}
migrationPlanNotReviewed: This plan hasn't been reviewed yet (it's {status}). The reviewer is {reviewer}.
migrationReviewerOnly: The old-memory migration is reviewed by {reviewer}, not you. The report is on plan {plan}.
migrationScopeMissing: {source} is to go to {scope}, but that scope doesn't exist yet
migrationSuggestNoTarget: {source} wants to make a suggestion but doesn't say where
migrationTypeInvalid: {source}'s type can only be user / feedback / project / reference, got {type}
migrationTypeWrongPlace: {source} has type {type}, which can't go in {destination} (user is always private, and team only holds project / reference / feedback)
migrationUnknownSource: A decision's source isn't a known old memory: {source}
migrationUnplaced: These old memories have nowhere to go ({count} in all): {sources}{more}
privateMemoryOwnerSees: Can't access someone else's private memory
